node.title: Re: use getpwent to find users and delete them
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: If you use [doc://system|system LIST] with the list having more than one element, then your command line arguments need to be separate elements, otherwise you're currently trying to run a program named literally "sudo /usr/sbin/userdel". Try my @cmd = ("sudo", "/usr/sbin/userdel", "-r", $account);.
